baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sign frame, the naming of night, and the resulting plural state of darkness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus first presents an observable day-night opposition: illumination is present, then removed, and the addressed observers abruptly occupy darkness.

activation_trace.role: A manifest marker makes the transition something displayed for recognition rather than mere background chronology.
Night contributes the dark contrary of day and supplies the initial side of the opposition.
Day contributes the interval opened by illumination whose loss makes the final state perceptible.

changed_reading.before: Darkness simply follows daylight in the ordinary daily sequence.
changed_reading.after: The ordinary opposition is staged as a visible sign whose decisive result is that the observers themselves suddenly stand in darkness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction `naslakhu minhu al-nahara`, especially the choice of stripping rather than merely replacing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night functions as a substrate or body and daylight as an attached covering: removing the luminous layer exposes the darkness that was structurally prior in the image.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the dark body from which the contrasting day is said to be removed.
Peeling skin or rind supplies a material separation between an outer layer and what remains beneath.
Removing clothing sharpens the image of light as a covering taken off a body.
Opening and widening supplies daylight as an expanded field that can be withdrawn from the enclosing night.

changed_reading.after: Daylight is an extractable skin or garment on night, so darkness appears as the exposed remainder rather than a newly imported substance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The stripping verb together with the threshold force of `fa-idha`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The material verb also denotes a period reaching its end; the focus therefore compresses gradual temporal expiration into a suddenly recognized boundary-state.

activation_trace.role: A month or day slipping out of its term supplies temporal completion beneath the physical stripping image.
The night nearest the speaking day supplies a concrete adjacent interval rather than abstract darkness.
The visible marker turns the completed boundary into something that can be noticed and read.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a continuous fading of evening light.
changed_reading.after: It marks the expiration of a luminous term: a gradual process crosses a threshold and is registered all at once as darkness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sign revives dead earth and brings hidden grain out of it; the focus sign then reverses the direction by stripping daylight out of night. Creation is displayed through paired emergence and withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Material peeling anchors the focus side of the paired extraction mechanism.
The same manifest-sign frame places the earth transformation in direct formal relation to the focus.
Lifeless land supplies the closed or inactive substrate from which the first sign begins.
Earth enlivened through rain and growth supplies the positive transformation paired with daylight withdrawal.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the outward direction that the focus's stripping reverses.
The germinable grain makes the preceding extraction productive rather than merely spatial.
Joining counterparts licenses reading emergence and withdrawal as coordinated polar operations.

structural_cues: 36:33 and 36:37 open with the same sign-for-them frame.
The source/container language of 36:33 immediately precedes the focus's `minhu` construction.
36:36 inserts universal pairing between the two signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent matched sign frames, concealed grain emerging, paired kinds, and daylight being stripped; I infer a reverse-direction pair, while the live alternative is that these are independent examples sharing only a rhetorical frame.

changed_reading.before: Day is peeled from night as an isolated celestial image.
changed_reading.after: The peeling is the subtractive half of a paired creative grammar: dead earth releases life outward, while night has its luminous layer drawn away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following sun, moon, and orbit sequence places the stripping inside a measured circulation with limits, return, and non-overtaking. The violent material verb describes a regulated handoff rather than disorder.

activation_trace.role: Temporal slipping-out anchors the focus as one completed phase in a larger cycle.
Continuous flowing motion supplies the ongoing process within which the day-night threshold occurs.
A fixed settlement or limit gives the motion a terminal boundary.
Deliberate apportioning supplies governance and measure to the transition.
Return after departure supplies recurrence rather than one-way loss.
Counted time and its recurrence sharpen the measured periodic side of the same mapped occurrence.
Night reappears explicitly as one member of the regulated opposition.
Precedence and racing supply the prohibited mechanism: neither phase breaches the ordered handoff.
Daylight reappears as the other explicit member of the bounded sequence.
Circular turning supplies the geometry that returns the stripped phase.
Running or swimming supplies coordinated traversal rather than collision.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 directly continue the focus with sun, moon, night, day, limits, and orbital motion.
The sequence moves from one stripping event to a general rule that neither luminous body nor temporal phase overtakes another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, settlement, measure, return, non-overtaking, and circular motion; I assign these as the control system for the focus's stripping, while the alternative is that 36:37 remains a purely phenomenological sunset image.

changed_reading.before: Stripping suggests a forceful one-way removal of day.
changed_reading.after: The removal is a precisely bounded phase transfer inside a recurrent circulation, forceful in appearance but governed in operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier heedlessness, barriers, and failed sight and later turning away from signs make the focus's addressed `they` functional. The cosmic sign externally performs the audience's loss or refusal of perceptual access.

activation_trace.role: A visible marker anchors the focus as communication addressed to observers.
Lapse from alertness supplies the audience's initial failure to register what is before them.
Barriers closing gaps on both sides supply an obstructed field of access.
Physical seeing supplies the faculty disabled by enclosure and, analogically, by removed daylight.
Inner discernment keeps an epistemic reading live alongside literal visual incapacity.
Repeated manifest signs supply the class to which the focus sign belongs.
Turning one's side away supplies active refusal as an alternative cause of darkness to imposed obstruction.

structural_cues: The focus says the sign is `for them` and concludes with `they`, not merely that the sky becomes dark.
36:9 ends with their not seeing; 36:46 ends with their turning away from signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies addressed signs, heedlessness, blocked sight, inward discernment, and refusal; I transfer the physical withdrawal of light into a model of receiver-state, while literal night remains fully active and refusal need not be the cause of sunset.

changed_reading.before: The final plural pronoun only reports that people happen to be outdoors after sunset.
changed_reading.after: Their sudden darkness is also an enacted diagnostic: a displayed sign meets receivers already enclosed, unseeing, or turned away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated sudden-state constructions move groups from activity to quiescence, from graves to motion, into assembled presence, and into kindling fire. The focus's sunset joins a surah-wide grammar of instantaneous disclosure.

activation_trace.role: A term reaching its end anchors the focus as a threshold event.
A terrifying single cry supplies an abrupt trigger rather than a gradual transition.
Life or awareness stilled after motion supplies one collective terminal state revealed by the recurring syntax.
Wind sent into an object supplies another sharply initiating trigger.
Graves supply the closed prior state from which the collective suddenly emerges.
Immediate presence and witnessed nearness supply a further all-at-once collective result.
Ignition supplies a constructive sudden state that prevents the pattern from meaning catastrophe alone.

structural_cues: The focus's `fa-idha hum` state construction recurs at 36:29, 36:51, and 36:53.
Related `fa-idha` disclosures also occur at 36:77 and 36:80, spanning death, resurrection, disputation, and making fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax and abrupt outcomes; I infer that the daily threshold formally rehearses total state-change, while the alternative is ordinary stylistic recurrence with no eschatological transfer into 36:37.

changed_reading.before: Evening is a smooth meteorological fade.
changed_reading.after: The line renders evening as a miniature phase switch: one boundary is crossed and an entire collective condition is suddenly disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later sealing, effacing sight, losing the route, transformation, and inability to proceed or return generalize the focus's removal of daylight into removal of an enabling medium. Darkness is a loss of operational capacity, not only a color-state.

activation_trace.role: Taking off a covering anchors the focus as deliberate removal of something formerly enabling exposure and action.
An opened and widened field supplies the practical affordance lost when daylight is removed.
A secure preventing seal supplies a model of faculty-specific shutdown.
Loss of light and sight directly connects environmental darkness with disabled perception.
A cut-off route extends the shutdown from seeing to navigation.
The straight road supplies the actionable course that blindness makes unusable.
Ocular sight supplies the capacity explicitly absent at the blocked route.
Transformation of bodily form supplies a second mode of disabling an agent in place.
Passage forward supplies one direction of agency lost after the transformation.
Return to a prior position supplies the opposite direction that is likewise unavailable.

structural_cues: 36:65-67 form an escalating sequence of mouth, eye, route, body, forward motion, and return being reassigned or disabled.
36:66-67 repeat the same counterfactual divine-volition opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discrete losses of speech, sight, route, and locomotion; I infer a common medium-removal mechanism and apply it to daylight, while the alternative confines the focus result to visibility without wider agency implications.

changed_reading.before: Darkness is merely the visual property left after sunset.
changed_reading.after: Removing day withdraws the field that lets agents see, orient, and move, making `they are darkened` a compact capacity-shutdown model.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later green-tree/fire sign repeats the focus's source-pronoun and sudden-result grammar. A dark substrate yields day, while a moist green substrate yields fire: apparent contraries can hold or generate one another.

activation_trace.role: Dark night supplies the apparent contrary from which the luminous term is removed.
Peeling supplies the extraction relation that the later material sign reactivates.
Opened daylight supplies the luminous contrary associated with the dark source.
The actual stalked tree supplies the later material source rather than an abstract comparison.
Fresh green vegetation supplies the moist living quality apparently contrary to fire.
Kindled fire supplies the hot luminous contrary drawn from the green source.
Ignition supplies the sudden humanly witnessed release of the hidden opposite.

structural_cues: Both 36:37 and 36:80 use `minhu` to relate a source to its apparent contrary.
Both constructions culminate in a `fa-idha` disclosure involving the addressed human group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel source pronouns, sudden-result syntax, and contrary materials; I infer a shared hidden-opposite mechanism, while the live alternative is that night/day and green-tree/fire are separate demonstrations joined only by common diction.

changed_reading.before: Daylight is simply removed when its allotted time ends.
changed_reading.after: The night/day event demonstrates a wider material rule: what appears contrary to a substrate may be held within it and disclosed by transformation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily reports becoming dark, not being legally wronged. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory includes withholding and grievance branches and 36:54 later negates the same root in a judgment setting. Downstream prose must present deprivation only as a secondary root resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of `muzlimun` and the removal of the daylight field.

activation_trace.role: Withholding supplies an exploratory undertone of access being denied when the luminous field is removed.
The later judgment statement activates grievance and redress as a contrasting legal register of the same root.
Negated withholding at judgment limits the focus resonance to present loss of access rather than final injustice.

changed_reading.before: The final state is exclusively an absence of visible light.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary resonance, the stripped light images deprivation of orienting access, set against the later assurance that no due will be withheld.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the heavens through an organic skin-shedding analogy. It remains anchored in the focus verb's annual snake-shedding branch and is activated by aging inversion and renewed creation later in the surah. Downstream prose should render it as an `as if` model of periodic renewal, not as a claim that night is literally animate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The annual-shedding branch of `naslakhu` applied to the recurring day-night boundary.

activation_trace.role: A snake shedding its skin annually supplies an organic image of recurrent removal and renewal.
Life extended through time supplies the long-cycle biological frame.
Turning a thing upside down supplies bodily reversal within that temporal cycle.
Bringing a thing newly into being supplies renewal after decay or reversal.

changed_reading.before: The day-night cycle is a mechanical exchange of illumination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cycle behaves like cosmic ecdysis: night repeatedly sheds a luminous skin within a larger pattern of aging, inversion, and renewal.

strongest_changes: The focus's stripping image becomes a reverse extraction paired with dead earth releasing living grain.
The following celestial sequence constrains the forceful image inside measure, return, non-overtaking, and circular motion.
Repeated sight-blockage and sign-refusal move the result from ambient darkness into the receivers' perceptual condition.
The green-tree/fire construction reveals a shared mechanism in which apparent contraries can be disclosed from one another.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context exposed matched sign frames, repeated sudden-state syntax, regulated celestial recurrence, and a late material analogue whose source-pronoun pattern sharply reactivated the focus's layered-night reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the container-like relation between night and day is ontological or only visual metaphor.
How far receiver blindness should be read morally rather than as a formal analogy to literal loss of sight.
Whether the repeated sudden-state grammar intentionally gives sunset an eschatological resonance.
The legal-deprivation and organic-shedding readings must remain secondary resonances rather than lexical substitutions.
